title: A shifted truncated Gaussian keeps both separator corners positive (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- On the kernel `exp(-h^2 + h/2)`, truncated at bandwidth 2, deleting `{3,4,5,6}` leaves both Schur directions between vertices 1 and 8 positive.
- The forward entry lies strictly between `1/1600` and `1/1500`. The reverse entry lies strictly between `5/10000000` and `6/10000000`. The half-bandwidth in increasing survivor order is 3.
- Selected κ is unchanged. This uses `gamma=1` and `s=1/4`, not the eventual prime-scale gamma.
